rows.q: Who needs to approve a discount above 50%?
rows.message: This is a SAMPLE policy written for the DSports AI proof of concept. According to the Clearance and Promotion Policy, inventory older than 90 days is reviewed monthly for clearance. Stock with at least 180 days of cover is considered high overstock. Critical aging stock, which is older than 120 days and has at least 150 days of cover, is reviewed first. A clearance discount of up to 50% can be proposed by the merchandising team without further approval. Discounts above 50% require approval from the Head of Merchandising and the Finance controller. No promotion may leave a unit margin below 10% of the discounted selling price. Standard clearance promotions run for 14 days.
